about: Frozen on-disk vectors of gb_gatekeeper (SAFETY_AUDIT SA-6): every later build must verify these handles with these key files, or an enrolled lock-screen PIN stops verifying after the update.

scheme.handle: AOSP password_handle_t v2, 58 B packed: version u8 = 2 | user_id u64 LE | flags u64 LE = 1 (HANDLE_FLAG_THROTTLE_SECURE) | salt u64 LE | signature[32] | hardware_backed u8 = 0
scheme.signature: HMAC-SHA256(K_dev, scrypt(P = handle[0:17] | password, S = salt as 8 B LE, N = 16384, r = 8, p = 1, dkLen = 32))

enrolled_by: gb_gatekeeper 0.2.0 (binary sha256 505b404d0606bf80bcb41ff8a66a80c962934e3791d3b8db13645608da143d51), unit tests of its 2026-10-26 build
